discovery: Inflationary cosmology and the quantum origin of cosmic structure
motivation: Guth proposed cosmic inflation, and Linde developed it into a viable theory (new and chaotic inflation). Together they explained why the universe is flat, homogeneous and free of relics. Mukhanov showed that quantum vacuum fluctuations, stretched by inflation, seed all cosmic structure. He predicted a nearly scale-invariant, Gaussian, adiabatic spectrum with a small red tilt. Two decades of precision CMB measurements from COBE, WMAP and Planck, together with galaxy surveys, have confirmed these predictions quantitatively: coherent acoustic peaks, superhorizon correlations, Gaussianity, and a spectral index n_s of about 0.965, which differs from exact scale invariance at more than eight standard deviations. A speculative question about the first instant of time has become an empirical science. The idea that galaxies come from quantum fluctuations is one of the deepest connections between quantum physics and the cosmos, and it has been tested against data of extraordinary statistical power.
